Risk_Description: Hallucinated financial information provided to customer
Control_Description: RAG-only architecture; no open-ended generation; responses grounded in compliance-reviewed knowledge base only
Monitoring_Method: Accuracy benchmarking against ground-truth FAQ corpus; hallucination detection in sample conversations
Notes: Zero tolerance risk. If hallucination rate exceeds 2% on factual queries = No-Go or restrict to FAQ-only mode

Risk_Description: Failure to escalate emotionally distressed customer to human agent
Control_Description: Sentiment detection model; keyword triggers for distress; auto-escalation for negative sentiment score; topic-based escalation for complaints and hardship
Monitoring_Method: Sentiment classification accuracy; escalation trigger rate; missed-escalation audit (supervisor review of random sample)
Linked_Benefit: B-02: Better routing for complex cases
Notes: Must test with real distress language patterns across demographics

Risk_Description: Bias — lower accuracy for non-standard English speakers and dialects
Control_Description: Bias testing across demographic proxies (language patterns / question complexity / geographic region); performance monitoring by user segment; low-confidence auto-escalation
Monitoring_Method: Disaggregated accuracy metrics by user segment; fairness audit
Notes: Phase 2 multilingual support partially addresses this

Risk_Description: PII exposure in conversation logs or AI responses
Control_Description: PII detection and filtering (input/output); data minimization — no PII retention beyond session; encryption (TLS 1.3 transit + AES-256 at rest); access controls on logs; 90-day anonymized retention
Monitoring_Method: PII detection false negative rate; access log audit; data retention compliance check
Notes: Zero tolerance risk if materialized — triggers Incident Log + regulatory notification

Risk_Description: Prompt injection / jailbreak attack manipulates AI responses
Control_Description: Input sanitization layer; jailbreak detection classifier; output filtering for prohibited content; red-teaming exercises (pre-deployment + bi-annually); security monitoring
Monitoring_Method: Red team exercise results; security monitoring alerts; adversarial input detection rate
Notes: Financial services = high-value target. Must include in penetration testing scope

Risk_Description: Over-reliance on AI leading to reduced human agent capacity
Control_Description: Maintain minimum human staffing levels regardless of deflection rate; human agent capacity planning independent of AI metrics; clear escalation SLAs
Monitoring_Method: Human agent staffing levels; escalation wait times; agent utilization rate
Linked_Benefit: B-03: Agents focus on complex cases
Notes: Risk is organizational — cost savings incentive may drive underinvestment in human capacity

Risk_Description: Model drift or degraded performance over time
Control_Description: Monthly accuracy benchmarking against test corpus; drift detection on input distribution; automated alerts for performance degradation; scheduled model refresh/retraining cycle
Monitoring_Method: Monthly accuracy score vs. baseline; input distribution shift metrics; CSAT trend
Notes: Cloudflare model updates may cause unexpected performance changes — monitor after each model version change

Risk_Description: Customer confusion about whether they are interacting with AI or human
Control_Description: Clear AI disclosure at start of every conversation; distinct visual design differentiating AI chat from human chat; option to ask 'Am I talking to a person?'
Monitoring_Method: Customer survey — 'Did you know you were chatting with AI?'; usability testing
Notes: Regulatory requirement in many jurisdictions — verify local requirements

Risk_Description: Customer service agent job displacement anxiety and morale impact
Control_Description: Transparent communication: no layoffs in Phase 1; upskilling program for agents to become 'AI-augmented specialists'; agent involvement in AI testing and feedback; career progression pathway
Monitoring_Method: Agent satisfaction survey; voluntary turnover rate; training completion rate
Notes: Change management is critical — must start communication before development begins

Risk_Description: Regulatory non-compliance with consumer protection or data governance regulations
Control_Description: Pre-deployment compliance review and sign-off; ongoing compliance monitoring; proactive regulatory engagement; regular regulatory landscape scanning; audit trail maintenance
Monitoring_Method: Compliance audit findings; regulatory inquiry response time; self-assessment results
Notes: Financial services regulators are increasingly focused on AI governance — stay ahead

Risk_Description: System outage with no fallback — customers unable to get support
Control_Description: Graceful degradation design: if AI unavailable → display static FAQ + route directly to human agent queue; uptime monitoring and alerting; redundant infrastructure
Monitoring_Method: System availability (target ≥ 99.5%); fallback activation test results; MTTR
Notes: Test fallback scenario regularly — not just during deployment

Risk_Description: Cross-border data transfer violation via Cloudflare edge processing
Control_Description: Cloudflare data residency controls (geo-restriction); DPA with Cloudflare covering data processing jurisdictions; legal review of data sovereignty requirements
Monitoring_Method: Data residency audit; Cloudflare sub-processor list review; regulatory requirement updates
Notes: Cloudflare processes at the edge — verify which jurisdictions are in scope and configure accordingly

Risk_Description: Insufficient audit trail for regulatory review
Control_Description: Comprehensive conversation logging (encrypted); metadata capture (timestamp / session ID / model version / confidence score / escalation decision); 90-day PII retention → anonymized long-term retention; accessible to compliance on request
Monitoring_Method: Audit trail completeness check; compliance access test; sample audit exercise
Notes: Financial regulators may request conversation logs during examination — ensure accessibility
